story: Since the coup of 249 the Sima family had ruled Wei in all but name. Sima Yi was followed by his sons Sima Shi and Sima Zhao, who conquered Shu in 263 and took the title King of Jin. Sima Zhao died in 265, and his son Sima Yan inherited his position.

Months later, in early 266, the last Wei emperor, Cao Huan, abdicated to Sima Yan in the same kind of ceremony that had ended the Han. Sima Yan became Emperor Wu of Jin, with Luoyang as his capital. Having seen how the Cao family had been left weak, he gave his uncles, brothers and sons large fiefs and their own troops, hoping they would protect the throne.
story_zh: 249年政变以后，司马氏已是魏国的实际统治者。司马懿之后，他的儿子司马师、司马昭相继掌权，司马昭在263年灭蜀，受封晋王。265年司马昭去世，其子司马炎继承了他的地位。
几个月后，266年初，魏末帝曹奂仿照汉魏故事，把帝位禅让给司马炎。司马炎即位为晋武帝，定都洛阳。他认为曹魏亡于宗室孤弱，于是大封同姓诸王，让他们拥有封地和军队，希望他们能拱卫皇室。
jin-founded.why: The Jin went on to reunify China, but the princes' private armies set up the civil war that wrecked it.
jin-founded.why_zh: 晋朝随后统一全国，但诸王手握兵权，为日后的内乱埋下了祸根。

story: After taking Shu, Jin spent years preparing to conquer Wu. The general Yang Hu planned the campaign, and in Sichuan the governor Wang Jun built a great fleet of warships. Wu's last ruler, Sun Hao, was cruel and erratic, and his state was weakening.

In 279 Jin attacked along a wide front. Early in 280 Wang Jun's fleet sailed down the Yangtze. Wu had stretched iron chains across the river and set iron spikes underwater; Jin burned through the chains with huge torches soaked in oil. Other armies under Du Yu and Wang Hun advanced from the north. Wang Jun reached Jianye first, and Sun Hao surrendered with his hands bound.
story_zh: 灭蜀之后，晋朝用了多年准备伐吴。羊祜制定了伐吴方略，益州刺史王濬在蜀地建造大型战船。东吴末帝孙皓残暴荒诞，国势日衰。
279年，晋军多路并进。280年初，王濬的船队顺江东下。吴军在江中设铁锁横江，水下暗置铁锥，晋军用浸满麻油的巨大火炬烧断铁链。杜预、王浑等率军从北面推进。王濬率先抵达建业，孙皓自缚出降。
jin-wu.why: It ended almost a century of division and reunited China under one dynasty.
jin-wu.why_zh: 此战结束了近一个世纪的分裂，中国重归一统。

story: Emperor Wu of Jin died in 290. His heir, Emperor Hui, was mentally disabled, and his wife, Empress Jia Nanfeng, took control of the court by killing the regent Yang Jun in 291. This began a struggle that drew in eight princes of the Sima clan.

Over the next sixteen years the princes fought one another for control of the emperor. One after another they seized Luoyang, ruled briefly and were killed. Sima Lun even took the throne for a few months in 301. The princes hired Xiongnu and Xianbei cavalry to fight for them, and armies looted the countryside. The war ended in 306 when Sima Yue, the last survivor, took power and Emperor Hui died, probably poisoned.
story_zh: 290年晋武帝去世，继位的晋惠帝智力低下，皇后贾南风在291年杀死辅政的杨骏，控制朝政。由此引发了一场牵动司马氏八位亲王的混战。
此后十六年间，诸王为争夺对皇帝的控制权反复厮杀，先后攻入洛阳，执政不久又被杀死。赵王司马伦在301年甚至篡位当了几个月皇帝。诸王招募匈奴、鲜卑骑兵为自己作战，各路军队在乡间大肆掳掠。306年，最后的胜利者东海王司马越掌权，晋惠帝去世，很可能是被毒死的。
eight-princes.why: It drained Jin's armies and treasury and taught the northern peoples how weak the court was, opening the way for their invasion.
eight-princes.why_zh: 八王之乱耗尽了晋朝的兵力和财力，也让北方各族看清了朝廷的虚弱，为他们南下打开了大门。

story: While the Jin princes fought, Xiongnu and other peoples who had long lived inside the northern frontier took up arms. The Xiongnu state of Han, later called Han Zhao, grew strong in Shanxi. In 311 the regent Sima Yue died, and his army of over 100,000 was destroyed by Shi Le as it carried his coffin east.

That summer Han Zhao forces under Liu Yao, Wang Mi and Shi Le broke into Luoyang. They burned the palaces, killed tens of thousands of people, including princes and officials, and captured Emperor Huai. He was taken to Pingyang, made to serve wine at banquets, and executed in 313. Many northern families fled south across the Yangtze.
story_zh: 当晋朝诸王内斗时，早已迁居北方边塞之内的匈奴等族纷纷起兵。匈奴人建立的汉国（后称前赵）在山西崛起。311年，东海王司马越病死，护送其灵柩东归的十余万晋军被石勒全歼。
同年夏天，刘曜、王弥、石勒率汉军攻入洛阳，焚毁宫殿，杀害王公百官和百姓数万人，俘虏了晋怀帝。怀帝被押往平阳，被迫在宴会上身穿青衣为人斟酒，313年遇害。大批北方士族和百姓渡江南逃，史称“衣冠南渡”。
yongjia.why: It marked the collapse of Chinese rule in the north and began a great migration that shifted China's population and culture south.
yongjia.why_zh: 永嘉之乱标志着汉人王朝在北方统治的崩溃，由此开始的大规模南迁使中国的人口和文化重心逐渐南移。

story: Sima Rui, Prince of Langya, had been sent to Jianye in 307 and had built support there with the help of Wang Dao. After Emperor Min surrendered at Chang'an, Sima Rui declared himself King of Jin in 317, and in 318, on news of Emperor Min's death, he took the imperial title. He is known as Emperor Yuan.

His capital, renamed Jiankang, became the center of a new southern state. Refugee families from the north settled in the region, often in "lodged commanderies" named after their lost homes. Great clans, especially the Wang and Xie families, held the real power, and the emperors often depended on them. The court talked of retaking the north but rarely managed it.
story_zh: 琅琊王司马睿在307年被派驻建邺，在王导的辅佐下赢得了当地的支持。晋愍帝在长安投降后，司马睿于317年称晋王，次年得知愍帝死讯后即皇帝位，是为晋元帝。
建邺改名建康，成为新的南方政权的中心。北方南迁的士族百姓定居江南，朝廷往往以他们故乡的名称设立“侨郡”加以安置。王、谢等高门大族掌握实权，皇帝常常要依靠他们。朝廷虽口称收复中原，却很少真正做到。
eastern-jin.why: It kept a Chinese dynasty alive in the south, and the Jiankang court began the long development of the Yangtze region.
eastern-jin.why_zh: 东晋使汉人王朝在南方得以延续，以建康为中心，长江流域开始了长期的开发。

story: On the third day of the third month of 353, Wang Xizhi, then governor of Kuaiji, invited 41 friends to the Orchid Pavilion near Shaoxing for a spring purification festival. They sat beside a winding stream, and cups of wine were floated down it. Whoever the cup stopped before had to write a poem or drink.

Wang wrote a preface for the collection of poems. In it he describes the beauty of the day and then reflects on how quickly life passes. Written in running script, the manuscript is famous for its natural, flowing brushwork. Emperor Taizong of Tang loved it so much that he obtained the original and, by tradition, had it buried with him. Only copies and tracings survive.
story_zh: 353年三月初三，会稽内史王羲之邀请四十余位友人，在山阴兰亭举行修禊活动。众人沿着曲折的溪水而坐，把酒杯放入水中漂流，杯子停在谁面前，谁就要赋诗，作不出就罚酒。
王羲之为这次聚会的诗集写了一篇序。文中先写当天的良辰美景，再感叹人生短暂。这篇行书笔法自然流畅，被誉为“天下第一行书”。唐太宗极爱此帖，设法得到真迹，相传死后将它带入了昭陵。今天流传的只是摹本和临本。
lanting.why: It is the most celebrated work of Chinese calligraphy and made Wang Xizhi the "Sage of Calligraphy."
lanting.why_zh: 《兰亭集序》是中国书法史上最负盛名的作品，王羲之因此被尊为“书圣”。

quote.zh: 此地有崇山峻岭，茂林修竹
quote.en: Here there are high mountains and steep peaks, lush woods and tall bamboo.

story: Dunhuang was an oasis town at the western end of the Hexi Corridor, where the Silk Road roads split to go around the Taklamakan Desert. Merchants, soldiers and monks all passed through it.

According to a Tang-era inscription, in 366 a monk named Le Zun had a vision of a thousand Buddhas glowing on the cliff face of Mingsha Hill, and he cut the first meditation cave there. Others followed. Over the next thousand years, through the Northern dynasties, Sui, Tang and later, nearly 500 decorated caves were carved. Their wall paintings and clay statues show Buddhist stories and everyday life. In 1900 a sealed "library cave" was found holding tens of thousands of manuscripts.
story_zh: 敦煌是河西走廊西端的绿洲城镇，丝绸之路在这里分成南北两道，绕过塔克拉玛干沙漠。商人、士兵和僧侣都要经过这里。
据唐代碑文记载，366年，僧人乐僔在鸣沙山断崖上看到金光闪耀，状若千佛，便在这里开凿了第一个禅窟。此后不断有人接续开凿。从北朝、隋唐直到元代，前后一千年间共凿出近五百个有彩绘的洞窟。窟中的壁画和彩塑既描绘佛教故事，也展现了日常生活。1900年，人们在一个封闭的“藏经洞”中发现了数万件古代文书。
mogao.why: The caves are one of the greatest stores of Buddhist art in the world and a key source for Silk Road history.
mogao.why_zh: 莫高窟是世界上最重要的佛教艺术宝库之一，也是研究丝绸之路历史的关键资料。

people.name: Le Zun
people.role: Monk who cut the first cave

story: Fu Jian of Former Qin had united the north by 376. Against the advice of his ministers, he set out in 383 to conquer the Eastern Jin, with an army said to number nearly a million. The Jin court gave command to Xie Shi and Xie Xuan, with about 80,000 men; the minister Xie An directed affairs from Jiankang.

The armies met at the Fei River near Shouyang. The Jin side asked Fu Jian to pull back a little so they could cross and fight. He agreed, planning to strike them mid-crossing. But as his front lines moved back, a captured Jin officer shouted that Qin was beaten. Panic spread, the army broke, and Jin troops crossed and routed it.
story_zh: 到376年，前秦苻坚已经统一北方。383年，他不顾大臣劝阻，号称率百万大军南下讨伐东晋。东晋朝廷任命谢石、谢玄领兵约八万迎战，宰相谢安在建康坐镇指挥。
两军在寿阳附近的淝水对峙。晋军请苻坚稍稍后退，好让晋军渡河决战。苻坚想趁晋军半渡时出击，便答应了。不料前秦军队一后撤就止不住，被俘的东晋降将朱序在阵后大喊“秦军败了”，秦军顿时大乱。晋军渡河追击，大获全胜。
fei-river.why: The defeat shattered Former Qin, and the north broke apart again, while the south stayed independent.
fei-river.why_zh: 前秦因此土崩瓦解，北方再度分裂，南方则保住了独立。

quote.zh: 闻风声鹤唳，皆以为王师已至
quote.en: Hearing the wind and the cries of cranes, they all thought the Jin army had arrived.
quote.from: Book of Jin 晋书·谢玄传

story: Chen Shou was born in Shu and served there as a junior historian until Shu fell in 263. Under Jin he became an official in Luoyang and was given the task of compiling the histories of the three states.

He finished the Records of the Three Kingdoms in 65 chapters: 30 on Wei, 15 on Shu and 20 on Wu. Because Jin had inherited its throne from Wei, he treated Wei's rulers as the legitimate emperors. He wrote in a short, careful style and left out stories he could not check. In the fifth century Pei Songzhi added a long commentary that quoted many other sources. Together they are the main record of the period.
story_zh: 陈寿是蜀地人，曾在蜀汉任小史官。263年蜀亡后，他到洛阳任晋朝官员，奉命整理三国的历史。
他写成《三国志》六十五卷，其中《魏书》三十卷、《蜀书》十五卷、《吴书》二十卷。由于晋朝承接魏朝的帝位，书中以魏为正统。陈寿文笔简洁严谨，无法核实的传闻一概不录。五世纪时，裴松之为它作注，大量引用其他史料。二者合起来是研究这一时期最主要的史料。
sanguozhi.why: It is the source behind the novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms and the many stories, operas and games based on it.
sanguozhi.why_zh: 它是小说《三国演义》的依据，也是后世大量三国故事、戏曲和游戏的源头。

story: Liu Yuan came from the family of the Southern Xiongnu chanyus, whose people had lived inside the Han frontier in Shanxi for two centuries. He had grown up as a hostage in Luoyang and was well read in Chinese classics.

In 304, as the Jin princes fought, the Xiongnu nobles chose him as their leader. He declared himself King of Han at Lishi, claiming descent from Han princesses married to chanyus, and in 308 he took the title of emperor. His state, later renamed Zhao and known as Han Zhao or Former Zhao, sacked Luoyang in 311 and Chang'an in 316. In the same year of 304, Li Xiong founded the Cheng state in Sichuan.
story_zh: 刘渊出身南匈奴单于家族，他的族人在山西的汉朝边塞之内已经生活了两百年。他少年时在洛阳当人质，熟读汉人经史。
304年，正当晋朝诸王混战，匈奴贵族推举他为首领。刘渊以汉朝公主曾嫁给单于为由，自称汉朝外甥，在离石自立为汉王，308年称帝。他的政权后来改国号为赵，史称汉赵或前赵，先后于311年攻破洛阳、316年攻破长安。同一年，李雄在蜀地建立成国。
han-zhao.why: Historians date the start of the Sixteen Kingdoms, more than a century of rival northern states, to this year.
han-zhao.why_zh: 史家把这一年作为十六国时代的开端，此后北方诸国并立长达一百多年。

story: Zu Ti was a northern official who had fled south after the fall of Luoyang. In 313 he asked Sima Rui for permission to recover the north. Sima, more interested in securing the south, gave him a title, food for a thousand men and some cloth, but no troops or weapons.

Zu Ti crossed the Yangtze with about a hundred families of his followers. In the middle of the river he struck his oar and swore an oath. He forged weapons, recruited men and spent years fighting local warlords and Shi Le's armies. By about 320 he had recovered most of the land south of the Yellow River. But the court then sent a supervisor over him, and he died in 321, his work unfinished.
story_zh: 祖逖是北方士人，洛阳陷落后南逃。313年，他向司马睿请求北伐。司马睿只顾经营江南，仅给他一个官职、一千人的口粮和三千匹布，却不给兵马和武器。
祖逖带着跟随他的一百多户部曲渡江。船到江心，他敲击船桨发誓。他自己铸造兵器、招募士兵，多年与地方豪强和石勒的军队作战。到320年前后，他收复了黄河以南的大部分土地。但朝廷随后派人节制他，321年祖逖忧愤而死，北伐功败垂成。
zu-ti.why: His expedition became the model of patriotic resolve, and the court's lack of support showed how little it wanted to go north.
zu-ti.why_zh: 祖逖北伐成为志士报国的典范，而朝廷的掣肘也说明东晋并不真想收复中原。

quote.zh: 祖逖不能清中原而复济者，有如大江！
quote.en: If I, Zu Ti, cannot clear the Central Plain and cross back, let me be like this great river!
quote.from: Book of Jin 晋书·祖逖传

story: After Emperor Huai was captured at Luoyang, his nephew Sima Ye was made emperor at Chang'an in 313. He is known as Emperor Min. Chang'an was a shell of a city, with fewer than a hundred households and only four carts in the government's possession.

Han Zhao armies under Liu Yao attacked it several times. In 316 they surrounded the city and cut off its food. A measure of grain sold for two pounds of gold, and people turned to cannibalism. Help from the princes in the east never came. In the eleventh month Emperor Min rode out in a cart, carrying a coffin as a sign of surrender. He was taken to Pingyang and killed in 317.
story_zh: 晋怀帝在洛阳被俘后，他的侄子司马邺于313年在长安即位，是为晋愍帝。当时的长安残破不堪，城中人户不满百家，公车只剩四辆。
刘曜率领的汉赵军多次进攻长安。316年，汉赵军包围长安，切断粮道，城中斗米值金二两，甚至出现人吃人的惨状。东方各地的晋军始终没有来援。这年十一月，晋愍帝乘羊车、口衔玉璧、带着棺材出城投降。他被押送平阳，317年遇害。
fall-of-changan-316.why: It ended the Western Jin and left the Jin court only in the south.
fall-of-changan-316.why_zh: 西晋至此灭亡，晋室只剩下南方一隅。

story: Ge Hong came from a southern gentry family near Jiankang and studied with a Daoist master. He fought briefly against rebels and was given a title, but he was more interested in the search for immortality.

His book Baopuzi, "The Master Who Embraces Simplicity," was largely complete around 317. Its Inner Chapters describe how to make elixirs from minerals such as cinnabar and realgar, and record careful observations of chemical changes, such as turning mercury sulfide into mercury and back. Its Outer Chapters discuss politics and society in Confucian terms. He also compiled a handbook of emergency remedies. A recipe in it, soaking sweet wormwood in water for fever, guided Tu Youyou's discovery of artemisinin in the 1970s.
story_zh: 葛洪出身建康附近的江南士族，曾随道士学习。他早年参与镇压叛乱，因功封侯，但他更醉心于求仙问道。
他的《抱朴子》大约在317年基本完成。内篇讲述用丹砂、雄黄等矿物炼制丹药的方法，详细记录了诸如丹砂炼出水银、水银又变回丹砂这样的化学变化；外篇则以儒家观点议论政治和社会。他还编写了一部急救方书《肘后备急方》，书中“青蒿一握，以水二升渍，绞取汁”治疟疾的记载，启发了屠呦呦在1970年代发现青蒿素。
ge-hong.why: His works are key sources for early Chinese chemistry and medicine, with an influence reaching into modern malaria treatment.
ge-hong.why_zh: 葛洪的著作是研究中国早期化学和医学的重要资料，其影响一直延续到现代的疟疾治疗。

story: Huan Wen was an ambitious Eastern Jin general who held the middle Yangtze. In 346, without waiting for full approval from the court, he set out to attack Cheng Han, the state in Sichuan founded by the Li family in 304.

Cheng Han's ruler Li Shi was unpopular. Huan Wen marched up the Yangtze with a small army of about 10,000 men. In early 347 he defeated the Cheng forces outside Chengdu, though at one point his troops nearly broke and only a mistaken drum signal to advance saved the day. Li Shi surrendered, and Sichuan came back under Jin. Huan Wen's fame soared, and he became the most powerful man in the state.
story_zh: 桓温是东晋一位雄心勃勃的将领，镇守长江中游。346年，他未等朝廷正式批准，就出兵攻打李氏在蜀地建立的成汉政权。
成汉皇帝李势不得人心。桓温只带一万余人沿长江西上。347年初，他在成都城外击败成汉军队。战斗中晋军一度险些溃退，幸亏鼓吏误击进军鼓，士兵奋勇向前，才转败为胜。李势投降，蜀地重归晋朝。桓温声威大振，成为东晋最有权势的人物。
huan-wen-shu.why: It returned Sichuan to the south and made Huan Wen strong enough to dominate the court for the next quarter century.
huan-wen-shu.why_zh: 此战使蜀地重归南方，也让桓温此后二十多年得以左右朝政。

story: Former Qin was a state founded by the Di people, with its capital at Chang'an. In 357 Fu Jian overthrew his cruel cousin Fu Sheng and took the throne. He had already befriended Wang Meng, a poor Han Chinese scholar who had once met Huan Wen while picking lice from his clothes.

Fu Jian gave Wang Meng sweeping power. Wang punished lawless Di nobles and royal kin, revived Confucian schools, encouraged farming and built roads and post stations. Qin grew rich and strong. Wang also led the armies that conquered Former Yan in 370. On his deathbed in 375 he warned Fu Jian not to attack the Eastern Jin, and to beware of the Xianbei and Qiang leaders at his court.
story_zh: 前秦是氐族建立的政权，定都长安。357年，苻坚推翻残暴的堂兄苻生，登上帝位。此前他已结识了王猛。王猛是出身贫寒的汉人士子，曾经一边捉虱子一边与桓温纵论天下。
苻坚把大权交给王猛。王猛严惩横行不法的氐族贵族和皇亲，复兴儒学，奖励农耕，修建道路和驿站，前秦因此国富兵强。370年，王猛又率军灭了前燕。375年王猛临终时，告诫苻坚不要进攻东晋，并提防朝中的鲜卑、羌族首领。
fu-jian-wang-meng.why: Their partnership made Former Qin strong enough to unite the north, and ignoring Wang's last advice led to the Fei River disaster.
fu-jian-wang-meng.why_zh: 君臣合作使前秦强大到足以统一北方；而苻坚没有听从王猛的遗言，最终导致了淝水之败。

story: The Tuoba were a branch of the Xianbei people who had built a state called Dai on the steppe north of Shanxi. In 376 Former Qin destroyed Dai, and its young prince Tuoba Gui grew up in hiding with his mother's family.

After Former Qin collapsed at the Fei River, the Tuoba chiefs gathered at Niuchuan in 386 and made the fifteen-year-old Tuoba Gui their king. Later that year he changed the state's name to Wei. He defeated rival tribes and in 395 crushed the Later Yan at Canhe Slope. In 398 he moved his capital to Pingcheng, today's Datong, and took the title of emperor. He set his tribesmen to farm and adopted Chinese-style offices.
story_zh: 拓跋部是鲜卑人的一支，曾在山西以北的草原上建立代国。376年前秦灭代，年幼的王子拓跋珪随母亲投靠外家，在流亡中长大。
前秦在淝水之战后崩溃。386年，拓跋各部首领在牛川集会，拥立十五岁的拓跋珪为代王，同年改国号为魏。他先后击败周边部落，395年在参合陂大破后燕。398年，他迁都平城（今大同），即皇帝位。他让部众定居务农，并仿照汉制设置官职。
northern-wei-founded.why: Northern Wei went on to unite northern China and became the most important of the northern dynasties.
northern-wei-founded.why_zh: 北魏后来统一了北方，成为北朝中最重要的王朝。

story: Faxian was a monk in Chang'an who found that China lacked complete texts of the Vinaya, the rules for monastic life. In 399, already about sixty, he set out with a few companions to find them in India.

They crossed the desert near Dunhuang, where he wrote that the only guides were the bones of the dead, and then crossed the Pamirs. He spent years in northern India, visiting the places of the Buddha's life and copying texts. He sailed home from Sri Lanka, survived a storm that drove his ship to Java, and landed in Shandong in 412. His account, the Record of Buddhist Kingdoms, describes the lands he saw.
story_zh: 法显是长安的僧人，他发现中国缺少完整的戒律经典。399年，年近六旬的他与几位同伴出发前往天竺求取戒律。
他们穿越敦煌附近的沙漠，法显写道，路上只能“以死人枯骨为标识”；又翻越葱岭。他在北印度住了多年，巡礼佛陀生平遗迹，抄写经律。他从狮子国乘船回国，途中遇大风，船被吹到耶婆提（今爪哇一带），412年才在山东登岸。他写的《佛国记》记录了沿途所见各国情况。
faxian.why: He was the first Chinese known to reach India and return, and his record is a key source for the history of India and Central Asia.
faxian.why_zh: 法显是已知最早到达印度并返回的中国人，他的游记是研究印度和中亚历史的重要资料。

story: Kumarajiva was born in Kucha to an Indian father and a Kuchean princess. He became a famous Buddhist scholar. In 384 a Former Qin army captured Kucha and took him east, but Qin collapsed, and he was held for seventeen years in Liangzhou by the Later Liang rulers.

In 401 the Later Qin emperor Yao Xing, a devout Buddhist, brought him to Chang'an and treated him as a national teacher. Kumarajiva led a team of hundreds of monks that translated around 35 major works, including the Lotus Sutra, the Diamond Sutra and the Vimalakirti Sutra. His translations were clear and readable rather than word for word, and they replaced earlier, clumsier versions.
story_zh: 鸠摩罗什生于龟兹，父亲是天竺人，母亲是龟兹公主。他后来成为声名远扬的佛学大师。384年前秦军队攻下龟兹，把他带往东方，但前秦随即瓦解，他被后凉统治者滞留在凉州长达十七年。
401年，笃信佛教的后秦皇帝姚兴把他迎到长安，奉为国师。鸠摩罗什主持数百名僧人组成的译场，译出《法华经》《金刚经》《维摩诘经》等经论三十多部。他的译文通顺流畅，不拘泥于字面，取代了此前生硬的旧译。
kumarajiva.why: His translations shaped Chinese Buddhism and its vocabulary, and many are still the standard texts read today.
kumarajiva.why_zh: 他的译经深刻影响了中国佛教及其用语，许多至今仍是通行的标准译本。

story: Tao Yuanming came from a family that had fallen from greatness; his great-grandfather was the Jin general Tao Kan. Poor, he took a series of minor posts to support his family, but disliked official life.

In 405 he became magistrate of Pengze county. When a supervising inspector was due to visit, a clerk told him he must put on his formal sash to receive him. According to the histories, he refused to bow for five pecks of rice, the official salary, and resigned after some eighty days. He went home to Xunyang, wrote "Returning Home" and spent the rest of his life farming, drinking and writing poems about rural life. His prose tale "Peach Blossom Spring" describes a hidden village of peace.
story_zh: 陶渊明的曾祖父是东晋名将陶侃，但到他这一代家道已经衰落。为了养家，他做过几任小官，却始终厌恶官场。
405年，他出任彭泽县令。郡里派督邮来视察，县吏告诉他应当穿戴整齐去迎接。据史书记载，他不愿为了县令的五斗米俸禄向小人弯腰，任职八十多天后便辞官而去。他回到浔阳老家，写下《归去来兮辞》，此后终身躬耕田园，饮酒赋诗，描写乡村生活。他的《桃花源记》描绘了一个与世隔绝的太平村落。
tao-yuanming.why: He became the model of the scholar who chooses integrity over office, and the founder of Chinese pastoral poetry.
tao-yuanming.why_zh: 陶渊明成为宁守节操、不慕官禄的文人典范，也是中国田园诗的开创者。

quote.zh: 吾不能为五斗米折腰，拳拳事乡里小人邪！
quote.en: I cannot bow from the waist for five pecks of rice and toady to petty men of the village!
quote.from: Book of Jin 晋书·陶潜传

story: Liu Yu rose from a poor family to become the strongest general of the Eastern Jin. After defeating rebels and usurpers, he set out to win glory in the north. In 416 the Later Qin ruler Yao Xing died, and his state fell into disorder.

Liu Yu attacked by land and water. His fleet moved up the Yellow River despite attacks from Northern Wei cavalry on the bank, which he beat off with a crescent-shaped formation of carts. His general Wang Zhen'e sailed up the Wei River in covered boats and took Chang'an in 417, and the last Later Qin emperor surrendered. But Liu Yu soon hurried back south to take power at court, and Xia forces seized Chang'an in 418.
story_zh: 刘裕出身寒微，后来成为东晋最强大的将领。他平定叛乱、击败篡位者之后，决心北伐建功。416年后秦皇帝姚兴去世，后秦陷入内乱。
刘裕水陆并进，船队沿黄河逆流而上，北魏骑兵在岸上袭扰，被他用战车布成的“却月阵”击退。部将王镇恶乘蒙冲小舰沿渭水直抵长安，417年攻破城池，后秦末主投降。但刘裕急于回南方掌控朝政，很快南返，418年长安便被夏国夺去。
liu-yu-changan.why: It was the greatest southern victory in the north for centuries and gave Liu Yu the prestige to found the Song in 420.
liu-yu-changan.why_zh: 这是几百年间南方在北方取得的最大胜利，使刘裕有足够威望在420年建立刘宋。

story: Jia Nanfeng, wife of the disabled Emperor Hui, had ruled the court since 291. She was clever and ruthless, but the minister Zhang Hua kept the government running fairly well. In 299 she had the crown prince, who was not her son, deposed, and in 300 she had him murdered.

This gave Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao, an excuse. In the spring of 300 he led palace guards into the palace, arrested the empress and forced her to drink poisoned wine. He also killed Zhang Hua and other ministers. Early in 301 he deposed Emperor Hui and took the throne himself. Other princes rose against him, and he was killed within months.
story_zh: 智力低下的晋惠帝的皇后贾南风从291年起把持朝政。她精明狠毒，但靠大臣张华主持政务，朝局尚算稳定。299年，她废黜了不是自己亲生的太子，300年又派人将其杀害。
这给了赵王司马伦起兵的借口。300年春，他率禁军入宫，逮捕贾后，逼她饮下毒酒，同时杀死张华等大臣。301年初，他废黜惠帝，自己称帝。其他诸王纷纷起兵讨伐，司马伦几个月后便被杀。
jia-nanfeng.why: It turned the court struggle into open war among the princes, the most destructive phase of the War of the Eight Princes.
jia-nanfeng.why_zh: 这场政变使宫廷斗争演变成诸王之间的公开战争，八王之乱进入最惨烈的阶段。

story: In 307 the regent Sima Yue sent Sima Rui, Prince of Langya, to take charge south of the Yangtze, with Wang Dao as his chief adviser. Sima Rui was a minor royal with little fame, and at first the southern gentry ignored him.

Wang Dao, from the great Wang clan of Langya, arranged a public procession in which leading northern officials rode respectfully behind the prince. Southern families were impressed, and Wang then recruited leading southerners such as Gu Rong and He Xun into office. His cousin Wang Dun commanded the armies. As the north collapsed, the Jianye base became the refuge of the Jin court. People said that the Wang and the Sima shared the empire.
story_zh: 307年，东海王司马越派琅琊王司马睿出镇江南，以王导为主要谋士。司马睿只是声望不高的远支宗室，起初江南士族并不理睬他。
出身琅琊王氏的王导安排了一次出行，让北方名士骑马恭敬地跟随在司马睿身后。江南大族见状十分敬服，王导又趁机延请顾荣、贺循等江南名士出来做官。他的堂兄王敦则执掌兵权。北方崩溃后，建邺成为晋室的避难所。时人称“王与马，共天下”。
wang-dao-jianye.why: It created the base from which the Eastern Jin was founded and began the era of great-clan power in the south.
wang-dao-jianye.why_zh: 这为东晋的建立打下了基础，也开启了南方门阀士族掌权的时代。

quote.en: The Wang and the Sima share the realm.
quote.from: Book of Jin 晋书·王敦传

story: Sun En belonged to a family that led the Way of the Five Pecks of Rice, a Daoist sect. In 399 the Eastern Jin regent Sima Yuanxian drafted tenant farmers in the southeast into the army, causing anger. Sun En sailed from his island base off the coast and raised a revolt.

Hundreds of thousands joined him in the commanderies around Kuaiji, killing officials including the governor Wang Ningzhi. Sun En attacked several times and in 401 even sailed up the Yangtze toward Jiankang, but he was driven back by Liu Yu, then a junior officer. In 402 he drowned himself. His brother-in-law Lu Xun carried on, later nearly taking Jiankang in 410, until he was finally defeated in the far south in 411.
story_zh: 孙恩出身五斗米道世家。399年，东晋执政司马元显征调东南地区的佃客当兵，引起不满。孙恩从海岛据点出发，发动起义。
会稽一带数郡有数十万人响应，杀死了会稽内史王凝之等官员。孙恩多次进攻，401年甚至率船队溯江逼近建康，但被当时还是下级军官的刘裕击退。402年孙恩投海自尽。他的妹夫卢循继续领导起义，410年一度逼近建康，411年最终在岭南兵败。
sun-en.why: The war devastated the rich southeast and made the reputation of Liu Yu, who would end the Jin.
sun-en.why_zh: 这场战争严重破坏了富庶的东南地区，也成就了日后终结东晋的刘裕的声名。

story: Wang Dun, cousin of the chief minister Wang Dao, commanded the armies of the middle Yangtze. Emperor Yuan grew uneasy with the Wang family's power and began to rely on other ministers, Liu Wei and Diao Xie.

In 322 Wang Dun marched down the Yangtze, claiming he only wanted to remove these "evil ministers." He took the stone fortress outside Jiankang, defeated the imperial forces and killed several opponents. Emperor Yuan died of grief later that year. Wang Dun ruled from outside the capital. In 324 he rebelled again, aiming at the throne, but he fell ill and died during the campaign, and his army was defeated. Wang Dao, who had stayed loyal, kept his post.
story_zh: 王敦是丞相王导的堂兄，统领长江中游的军队。晋元帝对王氏权势日益不安，转而倚重刘隗、刁协等大臣。
322年，王敦以“清君侧”为名顺江东下，攻占建康城外的石头城，击败朝廷军队，杀死多名政敌。晋元帝当年忧愤而死。此后王敦在京城外遥控朝政。324年他再次起兵，意图篡位，却在途中病死，叛军随即被平定。始终忠于朝廷的王导保住了职位。
wang-dun.why: It showed that the Eastern Jin emperors depended on the great clans and their generals, a pattern that lasted until the dynasty's end.
wang-dun.why_zh: 这场叛乱表明东晋皇帝离不开门阀大族及其将领，这种局面一直延续到东晋灭亡。

story: Shi Le was a Jie tribesman who had once been sold as a slave. He became a general of Han Zhao, then broke away in 319 and founded his own state of Zhao, known as Later Zhao, based at Xiangguo in Hebei. Han Zhao, now ruled by Liu Yao from Chang'an, was known as Former Zhao.

In 328 Liu Yao besieged Luoyang. Shi Le led his army there in person. Liu Yao, who had been drinking heavily, fell from his horse in the battle and was captured; he was later killed. In 329 Shi Le's forces took the rest of Former Zhao, and in 330 he declared himself emperor. Later Zhao now controlled almost all of northern China.
story_zh: 石勒是羯族人，早年曾被卖为奴隶。他后来成为汉赵大将，319年自立，建立赵国，史称后赵，以河北襄国为都。此时由刘曜统治、定都长安的汉赵则称前赵。
328年，刘曜围攻洛阳，石勒亲自率军救援。刘曜战前酗酒，交战时坠马被俘，后被杀害。329年，后赵军队攻取前赵残余领土，330年石勒称帝。后赵几乎控制了整个北方。
shi-le-liu-yao.why: It made Later Zhao the dominant power in the north for two decades.
shi-le-liu-yao.why_zh: 此战使后赵在此后二十年间称霸北方。

story: After the cruel Later Zhao emperor Shi Hu died in 349, his sons fought over the throne. Ran Min, a Han Chinese who had been raised as Shi Hu's adopted grandson and was a famous fighter, became the strongest general in the capital, Ye.

In 350 he killed the Shi family members in Ye and took power. Because the Jie and other non-Han troops were hostile to him, he ordered them killed; the histories say over 200,000 died, though the number is likely exaggerated. He declared himself emperor of a state called Wei. Northern China fell into chaos and famine. In 352 Ran Min was captured in battle by the Xianbei Former Yan and executed.
story_zh: 349年，残暴的后赵皇帝石虎死后，他的几个儿子争夺皇位。冉闵是汉人，自幼被石虎收为养孙，骁勇善战，成为都城邺城中最有实力的将领。
350年，他在邺城诛杀石氏宗室，夺取政权。由于羯人和其他胡人军队与他为敌，他下令杀戮胡人，史书说死者达二十多万，这个数字可能有所夸大。随后他称帝，国号魏，史称冉魏。北方陷入战乱和饥荒。352年，冉闵在与鲜卑前燕的战斗中被俘，遭到处死。
ran-min.why: Later Zhao collapsed, and the vacuum let Former Yan and Former Qin rise in the north.
ran-min.why_zh: 后赵就此崩溃，前燕和前秦乘机在北方崛起。

story: By 369 Huan Wen dominated the Eastern Jin and wanted the throne. A great victory in the north would give him the prestige to take it. He led about 50,000 men north against Former Yan, using canals and rivers to move supplies.

He advanced as far as Fangtou, close to the Yan capital at Ye. But drought made the rivers low, and Yan forces cut his supply lines. He burned his boats and retreated by land. The Yan general Murong Chui pursued and ambushed him at Xiangyi, killing some 30,000 Jin soldiers. Huan Wen's reputation was badly damaged. He later deposed an emperor to show his power, but died in 373 without seizing the throne.
story_zh: 到369年，桓温已经独揽东晋大权，有意篡位。他想借北伐大胜提高威望，于是率五万大军讨伐前燕，借助运河和河道运送粮草。
晋军一路推进到枋头，离前燕都城邺城已经不远。但天旱水浅，粮道又被燕军切断，桓温只好焚毁船只，从陆路撤退。前燕名将慕容垂率军追击，在襄邑设伏，晋军死者约三万。桓温威信大损，后来虽废立皇帝以示权威，但到373年去世也没能篡位。
fangtou.why: The defeat ended Huan Wen's bid for the throne and made Murong Chui a famous general.
fangtou.why_zh: 枋头之败断送了桓温的篡位之路，也使慕容垂声名大振。

story: Under Fu Jian and Wang Meng, Former Qin had grown into the strongest northern state. It destroyed Former Yan in the northeast in 370 and took the Sichuan basin from the Eastern Jin in 373.

In 376 Fu Jian sent armies west against Former Liang, ruled by the Zhang family from Guzang in Gansu, which surrendered. The same year his armies destroyed the Tuoba state of Dai in the north. For the first time since the fall of Luoyang, all of northern China was under one ruler. Fu Jian was known for treating defeated rulers generously and giving them posts at court, which won admiration but left powerful enemies near him.
story_zh: 在苻坚和王猛的治理下，前秦成为北方最强大的国家。370年它灭了东北的前燕，373年又从东晋手中夺取了巴蜀。
376年，苻坚派兵西征以姑臧（今甘肃武威）为都的张氏前凉，前凉投降。同年，前秦军队又灭了北方拓跋氏的代国。自洛阳陷落以来，北方第一次统一在一个君主之下。苻坚对亡国君主宽大优待，让他们在朝中做官，虽赢得赞誉，却也在身边留下了强大的潜在敌人。
former-qin-unites-north.why: Unification of the north encouraged Fu Jian to attack the south, leading to the Fei River defeat seven years later.
former-qin-unites-north.why_zh: 统一北方让苻坚信心膨胀，决意南征，七年后遭遇淝水之败。

story: Southern Yan was a small Xianbei state in Shandong, founded by Murong De after the breakup of the Later Yan. Its ruler Murong Chao raided Jin territory in 409, carrying off people from the Huai region.

Liu Yu, by now the leading general of the Eastern Jin, marched north in 409. Against advice, the Yan let him through the mountain passes, and Liu beat them at Linqu. He then besieged their capital, Guanggu, for eight months. In 410 the city fell; Murong Chao was captured and executed in Jiankang. While Liu Yu was away, the rebel Lu Xun nearly took Jiankang, and Liu had to rush back to save it.
story_zh: 南燕是后燕分裂后慕容德在山东建立的鲜卑小国。409年，南燕国主慕容超派兵骚扰东晋边境，掳掠淮北百姓。
当时已是东晋首席大将的刘裕于409年北伐。南燕没有听从劝告据守险要，任由晋军通过山地，结果在临朐被刘裕击败。刘裕随后围攻都城广固八个月，410年破城，慕容超被俘，押到建康处死。刘裕出征期间，卢循起义军一度逼近建康，刘裕只得火速回师救援。
southern-yan.why: It brought Shandong back under southern rule and increased Liu Yu's power and fame.
southern-yan.why_zh: 此战使山东重归南方，进一步提高了刘裕的权势和声望。
